high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "barelyopinionated." The post is titled "Students use drone tech for rescue operations!" and is part of a series, as indicated by the number "2/9" in the top right corner. The content of the post discusses a solution developed by students from Govt Engineering College, Thrissur, to address the challenge of locating stranded people during the 2018 floods in Kerala. The students created a drone that can help detect stranded individuals, mark their locations on a map, and transmit real-time information to rescue teams.
